title: A way of working
body: Scroll through the four moves. Each one comes into focus as it reaches the centre.
instruction: Scroll inside the panel, or use the scene buttons to jump.

_items.heading:
Start with
what you notice.
_items.body: Slow down long enough to see the situation clearly. What is happening, and what might you be missing?

_items.heading:
Make room for
a better question.
_items.body: Look beyond your first explanation. Find the assumption that would change your next move if it turned out to be wrong.

_items.heading:
Try something
small and useful.
_items.body: Compare possibilities without needing a perfect answer. A modest experiment can reveal more than another round of guessing.

_items.heading:
Take the learning
back with you.
_items.body: Choose one action you can explain, test and review. Decide what evidence will tell you whether it helped.

microTask.instruction: Write the one action you will take and the signal you will watch for.

_extras.evidenceCue: the signal you chose actually moves.
